name: scatter
description: Scatter variant offspring across the parameter space

form_config.name: parents
form_config.label: Parent Individual
form_config.description: The individual to scatter from. Every offspring is a mutated copy of this parent, with no crossover, so scatter explores the neighborhood around one individual. To breed from several individuals, use Recombine.

form_config.name: offspring_size
form_config.label: Scatter Count (N)
form_config.description: How many offspring to make. Each is an independent random variation of the parent, so a larger count samples its neighborhood more thoroughly. An offspring identical to an individual already in the graph is discarded, so you can get fewer than N when Mutation Strength is very low.

form_config.name: noise_scale
form_config.label: Mutation Strength (σ, in units of each layer's natural scale)
form_config.description: How much each layer changes. Every layer that is on gets Gaussian noise with standard deviation σ in units of the layer's natural weight scale, which is set from the layer's width, so the same σ moves wide and narrow layers comparably. A fresh layer's weights are about 0.6 in these units, so 0.1 is a small step.

form_config.name: active_flips
form_config.label: Expected On/Off Toggles per Offspring
form_config.description: Average number of layers per offspring whose on/off state is toggled. Each toggle switches one layer from its parent's state, on to off or off to on. Layers in a new grating start on with no learned change yet, so toggles do nothing useful until a lineage has developed.

form_config.name: freeze_inactive
form_config.label: Freeze Switched-Off Layers
form_config.description: When on, a layer that is switched off gets no noise, so switching it back on restores exactly the weights it was selected with. When off, switched-off layers keep drifting unheard, and come back changed.

form_config.name: generate_exemplars
form_config.label: Auto-Generate Exemplars
form_config.description: When on, each offspring gets an exemplar as soon as it is made, using the settings of the parent's exemplar (prompt, random seed and so on), so you can compare offspring like for like. When off, offspring have no exemplar until you make one with Generate Exemplar.
